sources_note: 來源與日期逐篇列明。公司公告按原文歸因，開放範圍以可核對的資料為準。
sources_note_en: Each story lists its source and date. Company announcements are attributed and availability follows the documented scope.
thesis: AI走進商戶投放、電郵檢查及導購，測試階段與成效仍要分清
thesis_en: AI enters merchant campaigns, email checks and shopping while preview stages stay explicit
thesis_note: 印度商戶代理與Duet預覽擴大接入途徑，MAGI-2更新聲畫製作；日本服務、品牌背景及黑五導購提供具體流程案例。
thesis_note_en: Indian merchant agents and Duet previews meet MAGI-2 audio-video production, Japanese services, brand context and a Black Friday shopping case.
sections: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Pine Labs在印度推出商戶AI代理，Google廣告支出前須先批准
items.title_en: Pine Labs rolls out merchant AI agents in India with approval before Google ad spend
items.summary: Pine Labs宣布在Pine Labs One加入Guide及Marketer Agent，讓印度商戶查詢營業資料並設定Google廣告。
items.summary_en: Pine Labs announced Guide and Marketer Agent in Pine Labs One for Indian merchants to query business data and set up Google campaigns.
highlights: Guide涵蓋門店銷售、交易、結算及退款的自然語言問答。
廣告須商戶先批准才承諾支出；其他LLM渠道仍屬規劃。
highlights_en: Guide supports natural-language questions on sales, transactions, settlements and refunds.
Merchants approve campaigns before spend; other LLM discovery channels remain planned.
items.why: 營業資料與廣告設定放進商戶應用程式後，小型零售團隊可先把具體門店目標轉成活動，再決定是否批准支出。
items.why_en: Connected business data and campaign setup let small retailers turn store objectives into proposals before deciding whether to authorize spend.
items.next_step: 已獲接入的印度商戶可選一間門店，核對Guide銷售回覆，再檢查Google活動的關鍵字、素材及預算，逐項批准。
items.next_step_en: Eligible Indian merchants can choose one store, reconcile Guide's sales answers and inspect keywords, creative and budget before approving a Google campaign.
items.detail: 消息按Pine Labs公司公告轉載整理。Marketer Agent由Gemini支援，處理關鍵字研究、素材與活動設定；公司稱正在印度逐步推出。編輯建議把營業資料核對與投放批准分開記錄，避免問答看似合理便直接接受預算。公司對交易歸因及成效的描述未經本刊驗證，本篇沒有把後續渠道或代理商店的計劃寫成已全面提供。
items.detail_en: This is a reproduced issuer announcement. Gemini supports keyword research, creative and campaign setup during the India rollout. Record data reconciliation separately from spend approval rather than accepting a budget because an answer appears plausible. Attribution and performance are not independently validated; future channels and marketplace plans are not current access.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: MAGI-2旗艦版公布30秒聲畫生成，開源仍列後續計劃
items.title_en: MAGI-2 flagship announces 30-second audio-video generation; open source remains planned
items.summary: Sand.ai公布480B參數MAGI-2旗艦版，公司稱可生成最長30秒的1080p同步聲畫，並支援多媒體參照。
items.summary_en: Sand.ai announced the 480B-parameter MAGI-2 flagship, describing up to 30 seconds of 1080p audio-video generation with multimedia references.
highlights: 每秒25格，原生請求最多20項參照，並有時間線及局部編輯控制。
這次是旗艦版，與114B預覽版不同；開源權重及完整報告尚在計劃。
highlights_en: The stated limit is 25 fps and 20 references per native request, with timeline and targeted-edit controls.
This is the flagship rather than the 114B preview; open weights and a full report remain planned.
items.why: 聲畫與時間線控制接在同一生成流程後，創意團隊可先檢查短片的品牌參照及剪接節奏，再決定哪些鏡頭適合生成。
items.why_en: Combined audio-video and timeline controls let creative teams assess brand references and pacing before selecting shots for generation.
items.next_step: 取得接入後，用一份30秒分鏡指定參照素材、對白及剪接點，逐項記錄人物、產品與聲畫是否一致。
items.next_step_en: After obtaining access, specify references, dialogue and cuts for a 30-second storyboard and inspect character, product and audio continuity.
items.detail: 本篇依Sand.ai研究公告報道功能，沒有進行產品實測。參數數量是模型規模，不能代替對品牌文字、產品細節及鏡頭連續性的檢查。公司亦承認高速動作可能出現軌跡或連續性瑕疵。編輯建議把易出錯的動作與品牌元素列為驗收項目，並分清已公布能力、實際帳戶接入與尚待開源的權重，避免沿用預覽版資訊推定全部可用。
items.detail_en: Capabilities follow Sand.ai's research announcement, not our product trial. Parameter count does not establish accurate logos, product details or shot continuity. The company acknowledges possible artifacts in extreme high-speed motion. Define acceptance checks around motion and brand elements, distinguishing described capabilities, account access and future open weights.

items.title: Marcora上架Google Chat，把品牌參考庫帶進行銷與銷售對話
items.title_en: Marcora brings brand-reference answers and drafts into Google Chat
items.summary: Marcora宣布Google Chat行銷代理上架，團隊可在工作對話中查詢品牌定位與競爭資料，並草擬內容。
items.summary_en: Marcora announced its Google Chat marketing agent for brand-positioning and competitor questions and content drafts within work conversations.
highlights: 代理使用團隊整理的品牌基礎及參考庫，可組合不同角色與行業的訊息。
每人須連接帳戶；Google Workspace可能需管理員允許，Teams群組聊天不支援。
highlights_en: The agent draws on curated brand and reference material, combining persona and industry context.
Each person connects an account; Workspace approval may be needed, and Teams group chats are unsupported.
items.why: 已批准品牌背景進入工作對話後，產品行銷可決定哪些角色與行業說法可組合成銷售話術，並核對生成稿是否沿用正確依據。
items.why_en: Bringing approved context into chat lets product marketers decide how persona and industry messages combine in sales drafts and inspect their basis.
items.next_step: 選一個買家角色及行業，要求代理組合話術，逐句對照定位、產品與競爭參考，再把已確認版本存回團隊文件。
items.next_step_en: Choose a persona and industry, generate a talk track, compare it with positioning, product and competitor references, then save the reviewed version.
items.detail: 消息來自Marcora公司公告。Google Chat是這次上架重點，Slack、Teams及Buzz亦列為可用介面，各自支援的對話範圍不同。代理可把草稿保存成Marcora文件，讓參考背景與成稿分開管理。編輯建議核對每項說法的適用客群與來源，不把「採用已批准資料」理解為「AI生成稿已獲批准」；本篇亦沒有驗證公司對資料處理的保證。
items.detail_en: Google Chat is the new listing; the issuer also describes Slack, Teams and Buzz with different conversation scopes. Drafts can be saved as Marcora documents. Keep approved reference material separate from approved finished copy, checking audience fit and source support. This report does not independently certify the company's data-handling claims.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: SureSignal以beta整合廣告訊號，供AI買量與既有競價平台接入
items.title_en: SureSignal opens beta for aggregated signals feeding AI buying and existing bidding platforms
items.summary: SureSignal公布訊號聚合平台，以單一API、儀表板及合約連接獨立定向與衡量資料，現處beta階段。
items.summary_en: SureSignal announced a beta signal platform combining independent targeting and measurement inputs behind one API, dashboard and contract.
highlights: 可把組合訊號送入既有競價系統、精選交易與AI代理。
正與小型啟動夥伴群合作；訊號驗證與回饋機制按公司說法歸因。
highlights_en: Signal blends can feed existing bidding systems, curated deals and AI agents.
A small launch-partner group is involved; verification and feedback mechanisms are company descriptions.
items.why: 資料採購與媒體購買可分開管理後，買手可選擇要測試的訊號組合，決定哪些資料值得接入現有投放系統。
items.why_en: Separating signal procurement from media buying lets buyers choose blends to test within their existing delivery systems.
items.next_step: 申請beta時指定一項活動目標，要求列清訊號來源、驗證方法與混合權重，再與原有訊號設定做可比較的測試。
items.next_step_en: For a beta application, specify one objective and request signal sources, verification methods and blend weights before comparing with existing settings.
items.detail: 這是ExchangeWire PressBox刊載的公司公告，並非本刊獨立驗證訊號品質。SSA可理解為把多種廣告訊號集中處理的聚合層，並非另一個媒體購買平台。公司描述用品牌及銷售衡量回饋下一輪權重，尚未提供本篇可驗證的成效結果。編輯建議先釐清每種訊號的覆蓋與評估方法，再決定是否以單一接入取代現有安排。
items.detail_en: This is an issuer announcement carried by ExchangeWire PressBox, not our audit of signal quality. SSA describes a signal-aggregation layer rather than a replacement buying platform. The company describes using brand and sales measurement to adjust future weights, without independently verified results here. Clarify coverage and evaluation methods before changing existing integrations.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: transcosmos宣布採用Profound，支援日本及多語AI搜尋優化
items.title_en: transcosmos adopts Profound to support AI search optimization in Japan and across languages
items.summary: transcosmos宣布將Profound用作trans-GEO的分析與衡量基礎，把AI搜尋觀察連到網站及內容優化。
items.summary_en: transcosmos announced plans to use Profound as trans-GEO's analytics and measurement foundation, linking AI-search observations with website and content work.
highlights: 追蹤品牌在AI答案中的出現、引用及推薦，支援診斷。
服務包括內容、資訊架構及網站優化，亦涵蓋多語言。
highlights_en: Brand appearances, citations and recommendations support diagnostics.
Services cover content, information architecture and website optimization across languages.
items.why: AI答案觀察加入網站診斷後，服務團隊可按語言及問題找出資訊缺口，決定先修訂哪些頁面與內容結構。
items.why_en: AI-answer observations can help service teams identify language- and query-specific gaps and prioritize pages and information architecture.
items.next_step: 選一個日文產品頁及對應英文頁，列出相同購買問題，核對品牌引用與頁面資料差異，再排定內容修訂次序。
items.next_step_en: Compare one Japanese product page with its English counterpart against matching purchase questions, then prioritize revisions from citation and information gaps.
items.detail: 生成式引擎優化是讓公司資料更容易被AI搜尋理解及引用的內容與網站工作。這次屬transcosmos服務採用公告，與Profound早前的Teams介面及亞太辦公室消息不同。編輯建議把觀察時點、語言與實際頁面一併保存，讓改版前後可以比較；公司對準確度及品牌可見度的描述，不能直接當成已證明的新增客戶或保證推薦。
items.detail_en: Generative engine optimization concerns how AI search understands and cites company information. This service-adoption announcement differs from earlier Profound interface and office news. Retain observation dates, languages and page versions for comparisons. Supplier claims about accuracy or visibility do not establish new customers or guaranteed recommendations.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: transcosmos推出trans-AI Voice，把門店對話接到顧客資料與行銷跟進
items.title_en: transcosmos launches trans-AI Voice to connect offline conversations with customer data and follow-up
items.summary: transcosmos公布trans-AI Voice，結合對話記錄、AI洞察及顧客資料平台，把線下互動帶進銷售與行銷流程。
items.summary_en: transcosmos announced trans-AI Voice, combining conversation capture, AI insights and customer-data connections for sales and marketing workflows.
highlights: 涵蓋門店、商務會議及聯絡中心，透過Treasure AI Voice記錄及摘要。
對話可結合購買與行為資料，再接入CRM及行銷自動化；成效未經本刊驗證。
highlights_en: Treasure AI Voice captures and summarizes store, meeting and contact-center conversations.
Conversation data can join purchase and behavioral records and feed CRM and marketing automation; outcomes are not independently verified.
items.why: 線下顧慮可與交易資料對照後，零售及B2B團隊可決定哪些產品說明或跟進訊息需要修訂，而非只依賴前線印象。
items.why_en: Comparing offline concerns with transaction data can help retail and B2B teams prioritize product explanations and follow-up messages.
items.next_step: 選一類獲准記錄的門店諮詢，人工核對AI摘要中的購買顧慮，再與CRM記錄配對，測試一項針對性的跟進訊息。
items.next_step_en: Choose an authorized store-consultation category, check AI summaries of purchase concerns, match CRM records and test one targeted follow-up.
items.detail: VoC即顧客之聲，CDP則是整合顧客資料的平台。這次新服務把原本分散的線下對話與後續系統相連，屬公司公布的處理機制。AI摘要仍須與原對話核對，記錄範圍及用途亦應按實際場景確認。編輯建議先找出一項可追溯的顧慮與跟進決定，再評估訊息是否改善；本篇沒有把供應商對贏單率或收入的描述當成已證明結果。
items.detail_en: VoC means voice of the customer; a CDP unifies customer data. The announcement describes connecting fragmented offline dialogue to downstream systems. Check summaries against the conversation and confirm recording scope and purpose. Start with one traceable concern and follow-up decision; supplier statements do not establish higher win rates or revenue.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Stensul檢查電郵優惠是否易被AI讀取，摘要預覽仍待推出
items.title_en: Stensul checks whether email offers are AI-readable; summary preview remains planned
items.summary: Stensul新增寄送前AI優惠可讀性檢查及Gmail促銷註記，摘要預覽則計劃於2027年初推出。
items.summary_en: Stensul added pre-send AI offer-readability checks and Gmail Promotions annotations; summary preview is planned for early 2027.
highlights: 檢查優惠藏在圖片、欠缺預覽文字及主旨與正文不一致等問題。
促銷註記按電郵設定並由管理員授權；現有功能並非Gmail摘要模擬器。
highlights_en: Checks flag image-only offers, missing preheaders and subject-body mismatches.
Annotations are set per email under admin controls; the current feature is not a Gmail summary simulator.
items.why: 優惠可讀性加入寄送前檢查後，電郵團隊可決定哪些圖片優惠須補成文字，以及哪些促銷資料需要逐封更新。
items.why_en: Pre-send readability checks help email teams identify offers needing live text and promotion details requiring per-message updates.
items.next_step: 取同一優惠的圖片版與文字版，檢查兩者是否被指出缺漏，再核對主旨、預覽文字、促銷碼及到期日是否一致。
items.next_step_en: Compare image-only and live-text versions of one offer, then reconcile subject, preheader, promo code and expiry date before approval.
items.detail: QA即寄送前的品質檢查。消息按Business Wire公司新聞稿整理，原公告日期是11月23日，而非其他網站轉載日期。這次檢查重點是讓優惠資料可讀，不能保證Gmail一定採用某段摘要或促銷呈現。編輯建議把修訂原因記在電郵版本旁，保留正式批准環節；2027年初的預覽計劃與已提供的檢查功能應分開評估。
items.detail_en: QA means quality assurance before sending. This report follows the November 23 issuer release, not later republication dates. Readable offers do not guarantee a particular Gmail summary or display. Record revisions alongside email versions and retain approval; evaluate the planned 2027 preview separately from current checks.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: OpenAI披露Clay案例：客戶研究進入ChatGPT與Codex，模型按任務分工
items.title_en: OpenAI details Clay's customer-research workflows in ChatGPT and Codex
items.summary: OpenAI在11月24日客戶案例中描述Clay如何把潛客研究、資料補全及市場拓展流程帶入ChatGPT與Codex。
items.summary_en: OpenAI's November 24 customer story describes Clay bringing prospect research, enrichment and go-to-market workflows into ChatGPT and Codex.
highlights: Claygent使用模型做研究、資格判斷、資料補全與訊號偵測。
Sol作主要模型，Astra處理較難任務，Luna用於成本敏感工作；未披露獨立銷售成效。
highlights_en: Claygent uses models for research, qualification, enrichment and signal detection.
Sol is primary, Astra handles harder tasks and Luna cost-sensitive work; no independent sales results are supplied.
items.why: 同一客戶背景可跨研究與銷售工作使用後，B2B團隊可決定哪些資料需先補全，以及哪些任務值得配置較高推理成本。
items.why_en: Shared account context helps B2B teams prioritize enrichment and decide which tasks merit more expensive reasoning.
items.next_step: 選一組潛客，把公開研究、資格判斷及銷售簡報分開列成任務，比較各步資料依據與成本，再決定模型分工。
items.next_step_en: Separate public research, qualification and briefing for a lead sample, then compare evidence and cost at each step before choosing model roles.
items.detail: 這是模型供應商發布的客戶案例，日期代表新案例披露，並非整合首次上線。GTM即市場拓展，指把客戶資料轉成接觸及銷售安排的流程。案例說明不同模型與介面的用途，沒有本刊驗證的勝單或收入提升。編輯建議保留每項客戶判斷的來源，並把未來語音演示及其他構想與現有研究功能分開，避免由願景推定已可使用。
items.detail_en: This is a vendor-published customer story, not a dated integration launch. Go-to-market workflows turn account data into outreach and sales activity. Model and interface roles are described without independently verified wins or revenue. Retain evidence behind account judgments and distinguish existing research from prospective voice demonstrations and other future ideas.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: MYAVANA黑五活動先做AI髮質分析，再導向個人化產品選購
items.title_en: MYAVANA's Black Friday campaign puts AI hair profiling before personalized shopping
items.summary: UrbanGeekz報道，Meet MYAVANA活動以HairAI髮質分析引導產品推薦，再連接零售夥伴的選購流程。
items.summary_en: UrbanGeekz reports that Meet MYAVANA uses HairAI profiling to guide personalized product discovery and shopping through retail partners.
highlights: 用戶先建立Hair ID，再按髮質需求及天氣等背景取得推薦。
活動將於11月27至30日推動黑五至網購星期一選購；未公布銷售成效。
highlights_en: Users establish a Hair ID before recommendations based on hair needs and context such as weather.
The campaign promotes shopping for November 27–30, from Black Friday to Cyber Monday; no sales results are reported.
items.why: AI分析放在優惠之前，美容行銷團隊可決定導購入口先問哪些髮質需要，再把適合的商品與零售連結呈現給用戶。
items.why_en: Putting profiling before discounts helps beauty marketers specify which hair needs to capture before presenting products and retail links.
items.next_step: 檢視一次Hair ID到產品推薦再到零售頁的流程，列清每步使用的需求訊號，核對推薦理由與商品資料能否對應。
items.next_step_en: Review the Hair ID-to-recommendation-to-retailer journey, identify each need signal and check whether recommendation reasons match product information.
items.detail: 本篇報道的是假日活動機制，並不把11月25日當成AI助理首次推出日期。Hair ID可理解為用於產品配對的個人髮質檔案；品牌說法仍須與實際產品資料分開。編輯建議檢查推薦理由、零售連結及用戶看到的優惠是否一致，避免由個人化流程推定已改善髮質或提升轉換。這是一個AI導購案例，並非一般代言活動或已驗證成效報告。
items.detail_en: The news is the holiday activation, not a November 25 debut for the assistant. Hair ID is a profile used for product matching. Check recommendation reasons, retail links and visible offers against product information. A personalized journey does not establish improved hair condition or conversion; this is an AI shopping mechanism, not an outcomes study.

items.title: Claude Duet研究預覽擴至印度，個人候補與企業測試分開
items.title_en: Claude Duet research preview reaches India with waitlists and separate business betas
items.summary: Analytics India Magazine報道，Claude Duet研究預覽擴至印度，個人方案候補、Team公開beta及Enterprise私人beta分開處理。
items.summary_en: Analytics India Magazine reports an India expansion of the Duet research preview, separating personal-plan waitlists, Team public beta and Enterprise private beta.
highlights: Pro、Max及Ultra須加入候補，候補不代表帳戶已獲接入。
公司稱背景代理在發訊息、付款、簽署及刪除資料前須用戶批准。
highlights_en: Pro, Max and Ultra use a waitlist, which does not establish active access.
The company says messages, payments, signatures and deletions require user approval.
items.why: 印度團隊增加按方案申請背景代理的途徑，可先決定哪些客戶資料整理適合交予預覽，哪些對外動作仍需逐次審閱。
items.why_en: Indian teams gain plan-specific routes to background agents and can select data-preparation tasks while retaining review of outward actions.
items.next_step: 印度團隊先確認帳戶實際候補或beta狀態，再用一項客戶會議整理任務檢查背景輸出與發送前批准，通過後才擴大範圍。
items.next_step_en: Indian teams should confirm actual waitlist or beta status, then inspect one client-meeting preparation task and its send-approval step before widening use.
items.detail: 這次按直接報道中的Anthropic說法整理，並非本刊產品實測。研究預覽及beta表示仍處測試階段，個人方案排隊與已啟用的商業帳戶不能混為一談。編輯建議用同一項會議任務記錄代理提出甚麼、做了甚麼及在哪一步要求批准；這能幫助團隊判斷分工，不代表已證明省時、安全保證或香港亦可接入。
items.detail_en: This follows Anthropic statements in direct reporting, not our product trial. Research preview and beta remain testing stages; a personal waitlist is distinct from enabled business access. Log proposals, completed work and approval requests for one meeting task to assess delegation. No time-saving, security certification or Hong Kong availability is established.
